method: prequential own-self-play; each game scored only by its pre-game generation checkpoint
interpretation: Future games relative to the scored checkpoint; these games may train later checkpoints. Not a permanently held-out final-model test.

metrics.brier: mean squared error of win probability against player-relative terminal win label
metrics.value_mse: mean squared error on [-1,1] values; four times Brier
metrics.bce: stable binary cross entropy of raw win logits, in nats
metrics.reliability_bins: uniform probability bins, equal-game weighted; final bin includes p=1

weighting: uniform games, uniform retained searched positions within each game
sample_scope: retained searched positions only; not every robot turn

opponent_groups.weighting: uniform games, then uniform retained positions within each game
